title: Candidate Interview Log Form
subtitle: Use this log to record events in sequence, reconcile sources, identify trends and exceptions, and transfer the last known status for a candidate interview workflow.
description: An original operational candidate interview log form that controls a interview stage and candidate record from identity and routing through evidence, qualified decision, exception management, implementation, handoff, and final verification.
use_case: Use when the recruiting coordinator or interview lead needs a traceable log so the qualified recruiting or HR reviewer can advance, hold, decline, reschedule, or obtain additional job-related evidence under the approved requisition, structured interview plan, privacy rules, and applicable equal-employment requirements without relying on an informal email, spreadsheet, or unreviewed narrative.

sections.title: Candidate Interview log period, ownership, and control
sections.guidance: Open a bounded log with a clear owner, source record, entry standard, and review cadence.

blocks.label: Candidate Interview identity
Log ownership and routing
Log period and entry control

sections.title: Candidate Interview baseline, entry rules, and expected evidence
sections.guidance: Define the expected operating state so each log entry can be interpreted later.

blocks.label: Candidate Interview log-entry requirements
items: Active requisition and current position description are confirmed
Interviewers have assigned competencies and no duplicate coverage gap
Question set and rating anchors match the interview stage
Candidate identity is confirmed without collecting unnecessary identifiers
Format, access instructions, time zone, and contact route are accurate
Accessibility requests are routed to the designated confidential process
Panel conflicts or prior relationships are disclosed and resolved
Interview notes are limited to job-related evidence
Each rating includes evidence and an anchor-based rationale
Panel members submit independent ratings before group calibration
Candidate communication contains the correct next step and owner
Records are stored in the approved recruiting system with limited access

blocks.label: Supporting evidence and source records
items: Approved requisition and current position description
Structured question set and scoring anchors
Panel assignment and competency coverage plan
Candidate schedule and delivery confirmation
Individual interview notes and completed scorecard
Work-sample instructions, submission, and evaluator record
Conflict, adjustment, or incident routing reference
Candidate next-step communication and recruiting-system entry

blocks.label: Opening status, carried items, data sources, known gaps, entry conventions, and review assumptions

sections.title: Candidate Interview recurring event log
sections.guidance: Enter events in sequence and preserve actor, result, source, and next action.

blocks.label: Candidate Interview event and status log
Decision, correction, status change, reason, and authorization log
Sequence context, corrected entry, source conflict, missing interval, and interpretation limit

sections.title: Candidate Interview trend, reconciliation, and period review
sections.guidance: Reconcile the log to source systems and identify patterns that require a decision or corrective action.

blocks.label: Population, source count, log count, variance, owner, and resolution
Period review and decision checks
items: Evidence addresses the stated essential job outcome
Example identifies the candidate's own actions and contribution
Response shows relevant judgment, sequencing, or prioritization
Technical or functional evidence matches the approved question
Communication evidence is assessed against a defined role need
Rating cites observable evidence rather than personality shorthand
Follow-up prompts were consistent and job related
Missing evidence is marked unknown rather than inferred
Panel notes distinguish facts, quotation fragments, and conclusions
Scoring anchors were applied consistently across candidates

blocks.label: Period review outcome
Observed pattern, comparison basis, outlier, source limitation, operational effect, and decision need

sections.title: Candidate Interview unresolved event and escalation register
sections.guidance: Preserve exceptions separately from routine entries until final disposition.

blocks.label: Log stop and escalation boundary
blocks.guidance: Pause any action outside documented authority. Protect privacy, preserve the original evidence, and route urgent, safety, security, retaliation, or legal concerns to the qualified recruiting or HR reviewer under the approved requisition, structured interview plan, privacy rules, and applicable equal-employment requirements.

blocks.label: Candidate Interview exception and escalation triggers
items: Inappropriate or non-job-related question was asked
Candidate information reached an unintended recipient
Interview recording occurred without required authorization
Technology failure materially reduced the candidate's opportunity
Panel conflict of interest or prior relationship was disclosed
Approved interview questions or scoring anchors were not used
Candidate reported harassment, bias, retaliation, or unsafe conduct
Work sample, notes, or scorecard was lost, altered, or misattributed

blocks.label: Exception, immediate action, owner, due point, and disposition register
Exception facts, affected scope, privacy boundary, unresolved risk, and escalation rationale

sections.title: Candidate Interview period handoff and log closeout
sections.guidance: Transfer the last known status, open actions, and next required review to the receiving owner.

blocks.label: Log outcome and handoff
Open candidate interview action and limitation register
Closeout and recipient handoff confirmations
items: Final decision and effective boundary are recorded
Evidence supporting the outcome is linked and readable
Every unresolved action has an owner and due point
Sensitive information is routed only to the designated restricted record
Affected people and receiving systems received the necessary status
Conditions, limitations, and escalation triggers remain visible
Required payroll, schedule, access, asset, or workflow update is confirmed
Follow-up review or reopen condition has an accountable owner

blocks.label: Final evidence, decision rationale, remaining limitation, communication, and acceptance
Log accountable review
